method: numerical search of this atlas: orbit elimination with code/sym_elim.py for the subgroup C3 (moment equations reduced to the C3-invariant subspace), in several stages of 2400 s, started from the rule CA-T3-32-1768-PI-WHZ; nodes kept in the closed domain; proven with tools/verify_rigorous.py
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz

reproduce.command: mkdir -p out32 && python3 -c "import json,numpy as np;r=json.load(open('rules/worku_hicken_zingg_2024/tetra/CA-T3-32-1768-PI-WHZ.json'));np.save('out32/start.npy',np.c_[np.array(r['nodes']),np.array(r['weights'])])" && cd code && for each stage k with seed s_k (in the order of the seed list), start from the smallest rule written by the previous stage in ../out32 (the first stage from ../out32/start.npy): MI=40 NCAND=8 EXTTOL=1e-5 EXTIT=150 python3 sym_elim.py c3 32 2400 <s_k> <start> --out ../out32
